title: MakeRoad anchors ribbons at Center-(Width/2,Width/2) instead of Center-(Length/2,Width/2), displacing every road along its axis by (Length-Width)/2 px
detail: Slot rect center = Position+Size/2 = Center+((Length-Width)/2,0), shifted along the road axis. Pixel-verified in both committed frames (slice1-3-packet-mid-traversal.png): source disc spans x 203-225, road fill starts x 258 (~28px cream gap); road 2 ends x 449-452, ~25px past the sink disc edge (419). Roads do not run node-center to node-center.
recommended_fix: Use SetPosition(Center - FVector2D(Length * 0.5f, Width * 0.5f)) for the fill and Center - FVector2D(Length * 0.5f, (Width+4) * 0.5f) for the casing, then re-capture the look-parity evidence frames.

title: PacketPosIn double-adds the +0.5 tile center: packet dots render a half-tile (~12px) off the road they ride
detail: FPPScreenFit::GridToScreenX already adds +0.5f ((GridX + 0.5f) * kTilePx * Scale, PPCommandBus.h:33), so dots land one half-tile down-right of node centers. Pixel-verified in slice1-3-packet-mid-traversal.png: dot occupies rows 70-75 while the road band is rows 57-66 — the dot floats fully detached from the road.
recommended_fix: Drop the +0.5f in PacketPosIn and pass the raw integer node position (GridToScreenV already centers tiles): From = FVector2D(Node.Pos.X, Node.Pos.Y).

title: Committed look-parity evidence frame slice1-2-drawn-pipe.png shows roads painted OVER the router/sink nodes — a pre-fix build, contradicting the committed code
detail: Pixel-verified: in that frame the white fill runs straight through the router position (router gray visible only as 144px arcs outside the road band; 399px full disc in the newer frame), yet the code adds nodes after pipes (RefreshPipes -> RefreshNodes, 'node discs cover the road ends'). The ✅-scored evidence frame does not depict the committed code's render.
recommended_fix: Re-capture slice1-2-drawn-pipe.png with the current build after fixing the road-geometry bugs, and re-score the checklist against the fresh frame.

title: SnapToNode compares screen-space px against kSnapRadius defined in world px — effective E4 snap radius varies with window scale
detail: kSnapRadius=36 is 'world px, inclusive (E4)' (PP_Balance.h:49; Odin canon catalog.odin:181 'inclusive node-snap radius in world px'). D2 is measured in fit-scaled screen px, so the effective world radius is 36/Scale (~25.6 at the evidence window's Scale 1.40; can exceed the 52px two-tile E4 floor at small windows).
recommended_fix: Compare in world px: divide the screen delta by Fit.Scale before squaring (or compare D2 <= (kSnapRadius * Fit.Scale)^2), keeping the inclusive-at-radius check.

title: flow_summary.spawned is derived two different ways by the two writers SCHEMA.md claims are single-sourced
evidence:
ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,
--- tests/spine_check.cpp:641 ---
static_cast<int>(State.Flow.Packets.size()) + State.Score, // spawned = delivered + live
detail: PPProbe reports Demand.size() (all seeded entries); spine-check reports delivered+live. Equal (11) only for the pinned golden; at -ticks=50 the probe would print spawned=11 while 5 fired, and culling breaks the identity. SCHEMA.md's 'cannot drift' claim overstates.
recommended_fix: Pick one derivation in both writers (fired-count from the flow state, not Demand.size()) and document it in docs/goldens/SCHEMA.md.
